title: Intake and capture as an agent
description:
Reference capture, summary and (for papers) citation extraction run today as a procedure the router starts per new Reference. Give it a definition; wake it from the Reference change feed; keep its rules (never change curation status, never overwrite a person's text). Automatic acceptance becomes this responsibility's highest rung, with its learned threshold unchanged.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A new Reference is captured and summarised once.
- Acceptance happens only at the rung that allows it.
- Behaviour on Distinctive and the Hacker News sites is unchanged.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- intake-agent.feature: a new pending Reference is captured once; a person's pasted text is kept; at a low rung nothing is accepted; at the top rung acceptance follows the learned threshold.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Monitoring stack: router sends wakes.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
